title: sphaeralcea digitata
intro: Sphaeralcea digitata, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a perennial flowering plant that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeralcea digitata include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
